<js>
function setArgument(key, value) {
    var open_argument = source.getVariable();
    open_argument = getArguments(open_argument, '') || {};
    open_argument[key] = value;
    var result = JSON.stringify(open_argument);
    source.setVariable(result);
    return result;
}

var open_argument = source.getVariable();
var base_url = getArguments(open_argument, 'server') || '';
var ms = getArguments(open_argument, 'tone_id') || '';
var source_type = getArguments(open_argument, 'source_type') || '男频';
var tab = getArguments(open_argument, 'media') || '小说';
var sources = getArguments(open_argument, 'source') || '番茄';


var sdtoken;
try {
    var loginInfoMap = source.getLoginInfoMap ? source.getLoginInfoMap() : {};
    sdtoken = String(loginInfoMap['手动填写番茄token(可不填)'] || '');
} catch (e) {
    sdtoken = '';
}

var rawCookie = getFanqieCookie() || sdtoken;
var match = rawCookie.match(/sessionid=[^;]+/);
var fqcookie = match ? match[0] : '';
var fqssionid = '';
if (!fqcookie) {
    java.toast('您还未登陆番茄账号，无法同步数据哦！');
} else {
    fqssionid = getSessionId(fqcookie)
}
var fqsjurl = base_url + "/bookshelf?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;
var fqtjurl = base_url + "/fqrecommend?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;
var fqlsurl = base_url + "/fqhistory?page={{page}}&ssionid=" + fqssionid;

var groupDatas = [];
var infoData = [];

function deviceType() {
    try {
        return !!java.androidId();
    } catch (e) {
        return false;
    }
}

var hasValidCookie = fqcookie.length > 0;

if (hasValidCookie) {
    function groupQuery() {
        try {
            var url = base_url + "/group_name?ssionid=" + fqssionid;
            var res = java.ajax(url);
            var response = JSON.parse(res);

            if (!(response && response.data)) {}

            response.data.forEach(function(group) {
                var keys = Object.keys(group);
                if (keys.length > 0) {
                    var key = keys[0];
                    var value = group[key];
                    if (value && value.length) {
                        var option = {
                            "method": "POST",
                            "body": {
                                "book_ids": value,
                                "page": "{{page}}"
                            }
                        };
                        groupDatas.push({
                            title: key,
                            url: base_url + "/bookshelf," + JSON.stringify(option),
                            style: {
                                layout_flexGrow: 1,
                                layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                            }
                        });
                    }
                }
            });

            if (groupDatas.length % 2 !== 0) {
                groupDatas.push({
                    title: "--",
                    url: "",
                    style: {
                        layout_flexGrow: 1,
                        layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                    }
                });
            }
        } catch (e) {
            java.longToast("番茄登录过期，已隐藏番茄书架");
        }
    }

    try {
        java.longToast("正在加载分组数据...");
        var userUrl = base_url + "/fquser?ssionid=" + fqssionid;
        var userRes = java.ajax(userUrl);
        var userData = JSON.parse(userRes);

        var userName = (userData && userData.data && userData.data.name) ? userData.data.name : '未知用户';
        if (!userName.includes('未知用户')) {
            infoData = [{
                title: "番茄个人中心",
                url: fqsjurl,
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                }
            }, {
                title: "个性推荐(番茄)",
                url: fqtjurl,
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                }
            }, {
                title: "历史阅读(番茄)",
                url: fqlsurl,
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                }
            }];
        }
        groupQuery();
    } catch (e) {
        java.longToast("番茄登录过期，已隐藏番茄书架");
    }
}

var style_list = [];
try {
    var durl = `${base_url}/discovestyle?source=${sources}&source_type=${source_type}&tab=${tab}`;
    var res = java.ajax(durl);
    var result = JSON.parse(res);
    style_list = result.data || [];
    if (result.msg) {
        java.toast(result.msg);
    }
} catch (e) {
    java.toast("发现样式获取失败");
}
let qtcookie = cookie.getCookie(base_url);
let qtop = {
    method: "GET",
    headers: {
        cookie: qtcookie
    },
};
qtop = JSON.stringify(qtop);
let qtsjurl = base_url+'/get_book_shelf,'+qtop
let qtsj = [{
                title: "大灰狼个人中心",
                url: qtsjurl,
                style: {
                    layout_flexGrow: 1,
                    layout_flexBasisPercent: 0.45
                }
            }]
var finalData = infoData.concat(groupDatas, style_list);
finalData = qtsj.concat(finalData);
JSON.stringify(finalData);
</js>

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;
            
            if (targetParagraph.includes(twoChars)) {
                java.log("删除当前段落：" + targetParagraph);
                java.log("当前章节名：" + chapterTitle);
                java.log("相同连续文字：" + twoChars);
                paragraphs.splice(targetIndex, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n');
}

source.variableComment:
源变量

填写【移出/加入/移入书架数据】 —— 这是用来操作晋江app的收藏的，如
移出尚未分类::0 会把当前书籍移出晋江的收藏
加入尚未分类::0,1,1 会加入收藏至晋江的尚未分类书架
移入尚未分类::0,0,2 会把已加入晋江收藏的书籍移入晋江的尚未分类书架。
书架数据：在登录页的【📚获取书架】获取，获取后将显示在源变量设置
刷新详情页生效之后会删除【移出/加入/移入书架数据】字样。
填写【批量移出/加入/移入书架数据】则不会自动删除这些字样，在阅读的书架刷新会批量操作，需要手动删除，避免重复请求。

其他源变量操作请在登录里查看【使用说明】

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;
            
            if (targetParagraph.includes(twoChars)) {
                java.log("删除当前段落：" + targetParagraph);
                java.log("当前章节名：" + chapterTitle);
                java.log("相同连续文字：" + twoChars);
                paragraphs.splice(targetIndex, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n');
}

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;
            
            if (targetParagraph.includes(twoChars)) {
                java.log("删除当前段落：" + targetParagraph);
                java.log("当前章节名：" + chapterTitle);
                java.log("相同连续文字：" + twoChars);
                paragraphs.splice(targetIndex, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n');
}

result

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;
            
            if (targetParagraph.includes(twoChars)) {
                java.log("删除当前段落：" + targetParagraph);
                java.log("当前章节名：" + chapterTitle);
                java.log("相同连续文字：" + twoChars);
                paragraphs.splice(targetIndex, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n');
}

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;
            
            if (targetParagraph.includes(twoChars)) {
                java.log("删除当前段落：" + targetParagraph);
                java.log("当前章节名：" + chapterTitle);
                java.log("相同连续文字：" + twoChars);
                paragraphs.splice(targetIndex, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n');
}

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;

        }
    }

}

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;
            
            if (targetParagraph.includes(twoChars)) {
                java.log("删除当前段落：" + targetParagraph);
                java.log("当前章节名：" + chapterTitle);
                java.log("相同连续文字：" + twoChars);
                paragraphs.splice(targetIndex, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n');
}

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;
            
            if (targetParagraph.includes(twoChars)) {
                java.log("删除当前段落：" + targetParagraph);
                java.log("当前章节名：" + chapterTitle);
                java.log("相同连续文字：" + twoChars);
                paragraphs.splice(targetIndex, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n');
}

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;
            
            if (targetParagraph.includes(twoChars)) {

                java.log("相同连续文字：" + twoChars);
                paragraphs.splice(targetIndex, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n');
}

更改过发现要刷新本书源才会生效

❗️注意事项:
1、请不要退出晋江app的账号，只要点了退出，或者在其他地方登录了，都要重新抓token。
2、更新token，书籍就要更新目录。
3、【抓包token登录】和【账号登录】二选一，【抓包token登录】的优先级高些，填了【抓包token登录】，就是按【抓包token登录的值】登录

4、登录步骤【设备保护关闭的状态下】：
①填写好账号密码，点击“邮箱验证码”或者“手机验证码”
②填写好验证码，点击“邮箱登录”或者“手机登录”
③想要确认是否成功可以在登录UI里点右上角三点，查看登录头token里是否有值。
④如果弹出提示“请校检验证码”，可尝试填入上一次发送给你验证码。

5、如果邮箱和手机号无法登录，可能是需要过滑动验证码，可尝试先在晋江app里登录一遍后，再在阅读里登录，❗️还是不行就只能抓包token，填写在“抓包token登录”处。

    let sourceGet = String(source.getVariable()).replace(/\n*(?:请勿删除此书架数据)*❗️[\s\S]+?❗️/g,'');
	let token = Map("token");

	let ShelfJson = String(java.ajax(ShelfUrl));
    ShelfJson = JSON.parse(ShelfJson);
	    function extractClassInfo(obj, result = [], uniqueSet = new Set()) {
	    // 如果当前对象是数组，递归遍历数组中的每个元素
	    if (Array.isArray(obj)) {
	        for (let item of obj) {
	            extractClassInfo(item, result, uniqueSet);
	        }
	    } else if (typeof obj === 'object' && obj !== null) {
        // 检查是否存在 className 和 classId
	        if (obj.hasOwnProperty('className') && obj.hasOwnProperty('classId')) {
	            let className = obj.className;
	            // 如果 className 为空，设置为“尚未分类”
	            if (className.trim() === "") {
	                className = "尚未分类";
	            }
	            // 构造组合字符串
	            const combo = `${className}::${obj.classId}`;
	            // 如果组合字符串未出现过，添加到结果中
	            if (!uniqueSet.has(combo)) {
	                uniqueSet.add(combo);
	                result.push(combo);
	            }
	        }
	        // 递归遍历对象的每个属性
	        for (let key in obj) {
	            extractClassInfo(obj[key], result, uniqueSet);
	        }
  		  }
    		return result;
	   }

	let ShlefClass = "请勿删除此书架数据❗️"+JSON.stringify(extractClassInfo(ShelfJson))+"❗️"

	function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    
    // 检查第一段是否包含特定字符 ◎
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    
    // 根据是否包含特殊字符决定处理哪一段
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();

    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：、\.\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);

    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {

            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;

                java.log("相同连续文字：" + twoChars);
                paragraphs.splice(targetIndex, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n');
}

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;

    }

}

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;

                java.log("相同连续文字：" + twoChars);
                paragraphs.splice(targetIndex, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n');
}

function removeDuplicatedParagraphs(text, chapterTitle) {
    var paragraphs = text.split('\n');
    var firstParagraph = paragraphs[0].trim();
    var containsSpecialChar = firstParagraph.includes('◎');
    var targetIndex = containsSpecialChar ? 1 : 0;
    var targetParagraph = paragraphs[targetIndex].trim();
    var lastChar = targetParagraph.charAt(targetParagraph.length - 1);
    var isPunctuation = /[——◎。！？，；：\?!,;:》 】）”’…~"'\)]/.test(lastChar);
    
    if (!isPunctuation) {
        for (var i = 0; i < chapterTitle.length - 1; i++) {
            var twoChars = chapterTitle.substring(i, i + 2);
            if (twoChars === '  ' || twoChars.includes('☪')) continue;
            
            if (targetParagraph.includes(twoChars)) {

                java.log("相同连续文字：" + twoChars);
                paragraphs.splice(targetIndex, 1);
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return paragraphs.join('\n');
}

        author: m[4] ? String(m[4]).trim() : ""
    });
}

}

function mkBook(name, author, id, cover, intro, kind, size) {
    return {
        name: name,
        author: author,
        bookUrl: "https://app-cdn.jjwxc.net/androidapi/novelbasicinfo?novelId=" + id,
        coverUrl: cover,
        intro: intro,
        kind: kind,
        wordCount: size
    };
}

                    String(d.authorName || ""),

        java.log("explore ajaxAll error: " + eAll);
    }
}

// 兜底：接口失败时用页面上的书名直接构建（无简介）
if (books.length === 0) {

        books.push(mkBook(pageBooks[k].name, pageBooks[k].author, pageBooks[k].id, "", "", "", ""));
    }
}

result = JSON.stringify(books);
}

source.header:
<js>
let TOKEN = 'token://com.coolapk.market/c67ef5943784d09750dcfbb31020f0ab?'
let PACKAGE_NAME = 'com.coolapk.market';
let DEVICE_ID = String(java.randomUUID());
let APP_DEVICE = (length => {
  let chars = '0123456789abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ'
  let result = ''
  for (var i = length; i > 0; --i) {
    result += chars[Math.floor(Math.random() * chars.length)]
  }
  return result
})(50);

  let t = parseInt(Date.now() / 1000)
  let hex_t = `0x${t.toString(16)}`
  let md5_t = java.digestHex(t.toString(), "md5")
  let a = `${TOKEN}${md5_t}$${DEVICE_ID}&${PACKAGE_NAME}`;
  let md5_a = java.digestHex(String(java.base64Encode(a)),"md5")
  let token = `${md5_a}${DEVICE_ID}${hex_t}`

head = {
      'User-Agent': 'Dalvik/2.1.0 (Linux; U; Android 10; Pixel 4 XL Build/QQ2A.200405.005) +CookMarket/10.1.2-2004302',
      'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest',
      'X-Sdk-Int': '29',
      'X-Sdk-Locale': 'zh-CN',
      'X-App-Id': 'com.coolapk.market',
      'X-App-Version': '10.1.2',
      'X-App-Code': '2004302',
      'X-App-Token': token,
      'X-Api-Version': '10',
      'X-App-Device': APP_DEVICE,
      'X-Dark-Mode': '0'
    }
JSON.stringify(head)
</js>

☼版本号:{{$.version}}

☉最近更新：{{$.changehistory##\n.*}}

☪︎{{$.apksize}}/{{$.downCount}}下载/{{$.followCount}}人关注/{{$.commentCount}}人评论/{{$.language}}


‎

📖新版特性📖

{{$.changelog}}


‎

📖应用介绍📖

{{$.introduce}} if(/apk\/detail/.test(baseUrl)){ result = result }else{ result = "" }

ruleContent.content:
<js>
if(!/apk\/detail/.test(baseUrl)){
    let id = "{{$.data.id}}";
    let html = ""
    let item = JSON.parse(result).data;
    let curPage = 1;
    let lastItem = "";
    let resp2 = JSON.parse(java.ajax("https://api.coolapk.com/v6/feed/replyList?id={{$.data.id}}&page=1&lastItem="));
    let replynum5 = item.replynum;
    replynum5 > 100?replynum5=100:replynum5
    html += createReply(item)
    let item_reply = []
    let totalnum = 0
    let item2 = resp2.data
    item_reply = item_reply.concat(item2)
    while (item2.length && (totalnum = totalnum + item2.length) < replynum5) {
      curPage = curPage + 1
      lastItem = item2[item2.length - 1].id
      resp2 = JSON.parse(java.ajax(`https://api.coolapk.com/v6/feed/replyList?id=${id}&page=${curPage}&lastItem=${lastItem}`))
      item2 = resp2.data
      item_reply = item_reply.concat(item2)
    }

    let grouped_item_reply = {}
    item_reply.map(item => {
      if (item.rrid) {
        grouped_item_reply[item.rrid] = grouped_item_reply[item.rrid] || []
        grouped_item_reply[item.rrid].push(item)
      } else {
        grouped_item_reply[item.id] = grouped_item_reply[item.id] || []
        grouped_item_reply[item.id].push(item)
      }
    })
    for (key in grouped_item_reply) {
      grouped_item_reply[key].sort((e1, e2) => {
        return e1.dateline - e2.dateline
      }).map(item => html += createReply(item, !!item.rrid))
    }
    result = String(html).replace(/<a .*?href="([^"]+)".*?>([^<]+)<\/a>/g,'▪$2：$1▪')
   }else{
   	let html = "软件地址：\nhttps://www.coolapk.com/apk/{{$.data.apkname}}\n";
   	 html +="---复制下面文字到发现规则可看评论---\n"
   	html += "{{$.data.title}}▪回复::https://api.coolapk.com/v6/page/dataList?url=#/feed/apkCommentList?id={{$.data.id}}&sort=&title=最近回复&page={\{page}}&lastItem=\n"

html += "{{$.data.title}}▪发布::https://api.coolapk.com/v6/page/dataList?url=#/feed/apkCommentList?id=256030&sort=dateline_desc&title=最近发布&page={\{page}}&lastItem=\n"

html += "{{$.data.title}}▪热度::https://api.coolapk.com/v6/page/dataList?url=#/feed/apkCommentList?id={{$.data.id}}&sort=popular&title=热度排序&page={\{page}}&lastItem=\n"
   	}
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
if(!/apk\/detail/.test(baseUrl)){
    let id = "{{$.data.id}}";
    let html = ""
    let item = JSON.parse(result).data;
    let curPage = 1;
    let lastItem = "";
    let resp2 = JSON.parse(java.ajax("https://api.coolapk.com/v6/feed/replyList?id={{$.data.id}}&page=1&lastItem="));
    let replynum5 = item.replynum;
    replynum5 > 100?replynum5=100:replynum5
    html += createReply(item)
    let item_reply = []
    let totalnum = 0
    let item2 = resp2.data
    item_reply = item_reply.concat(item2)
    while (item2.length && (totalnum = totalnum + item2.length) < replynum5) {
      curPage = curPage + 1
      lastItem = item2[item2.length - 1].id
      resp2 = JSON.parse(java.ajax(`https://api.coolapk.com/v6/feed/replyList?id=${id}&page=${curPage}&lastItem=${lastItem}`))
      item2 = resp2.data
      item_reply = item_reply.concat(item2)
    }

    let grouped_item_reply = {}
    item_reply.map(item => {
      if (item.rrid) {
        grouped_item_reply[item.rrid] = grouped_item_reply[item.rrid] || []
        grouped_item_reply[item.rrid].push(item)
      } else {
        grouped_item_reply[item.id] = grouped_item_reply[item.id] || []
        grouped_item_reply[item.id].push(item)
      }
    })
    for (key in grouped_item_reply) {
      grouped_item_reply[key].sort((e1, e2) => {
        return e1.dateline - e2.dateline
      }).map(item => html += createReply(item, !!item.rrid))
    }
    result = String(html).replace(/<a .*?href="([^"]+)".*?>([^<]+)<\/a>/g,'▪$2：$1▪')
   }else{
   	let html = "软件地址：\nhttps://www.coolapk.com/apk/{{$.data.apkname}}\n";
   	 html +="---复制下面文字到发现规则可看评论---\n"
   	html += "{{$.data.title}}▪回复::https://api.coolapk.com/v6/page/dataList?url=#/feed/apkCommentList?id={{$.data.id}}&sort=&title=最近回复&page={\{page}}&lastItem=\n"

html += "{{$.data.title}}▪发布::https://api.coolapk.com/v6/page/dataList?url=#/feed/apkCommentList?id=256030&sort=dateline_desc&title=最近发布&page={\{page}}&lastItem=\n"

html += "{{$.data.title}}▪热度::https://api.coolapk.com/v6/page/dataList?url=#/feed/apkCommentList?id={{$.data.id}}&sort=popular&title=热度排序&page={\{page}}&lastItem=\n"
   	}
</js>

ruleContent.content:
<js>
if(!/apk\/detail/.test(baseUrl)){
    let id = "{{$.data.id}}";
    let html = ""
    let item = JSON.parse(result).data;
    let curPage = 1;
    let lastItem = "";
    let resp2 = JSON.parse(java.ajax("https://api.coolapk.com/v6/feed/replyList?id={{$.data.id}}&page=1&lastItem="));
    let replynum5 = item.replynum;
    replynum5 > 100?replynum5=100:replynum5
    html += createReply(item)
    let item_reply = []
    let totalnum = 0
    let item2 = resp2.data
    item_reply = item_reply.concat(item2)
    while (item2.length && (totalnum = totalnum + item2.length) < replynum5) {
      curPage = curPage + 1
      lastItem = item2[item2.length - 1].id
      resp2 = JSON.parse(java.ajax(`https://api.coolapk.com/v6/feed/replyList?id=${id}&page=${curPage}&lastItem=${lastItem}`))
      item2 = resp2.data
      item_reply = item_reply.concat(item2)
    }

    let grouped_item_reply = {}
    item_reply.map(item => {
      if (item.rrid) {
        grouped_item_reply[item.rrid] = grouped_item_reply[item.rrid] || []
        grouped_item_reply[item.rrid].push(item)
      } else {
        grouped_item_reply[item.id] = grouped_item_reply[item.id] || []
        grouped_item_reply[item.id].push(item)
      }
    })
    for (key in grouped_item_reply) {
      grouped_item_reply[key].sort((e1, e2) => {
        return e1.dateline - e2.dateline
      }).map(item => html += createReply(item, !!item.rrid))
    }
    result = String(html).replace(/<a .*?href="([^"]+)".*?>([^<]+)<\/a>/g,'▪$2：$1▪')
   }else{
   	let html = "软件地址：\nhttps://www.coolapk.com/apk/{{$.data.apkname}}\n";
   	 html +="---复制下面文字到发现规则可看评论---\n"
   	html += "{{$.data.title}}▪回复::https://api.coolapk.com/v6/page/dataList?url=#/feed/apkCommentList?id={{$.data.id}}&sort=&title=最近回复&page={\{page}}&lastItem=\n"

html += "{{$.data.title}}▪发布::https://api.coolapk.com/v6/page/dataList?url=#/feed/apkCommentList?id=256030&sort=dateline_desc&title=最近发布&page={\{page}}&lastItem=\n"

html += "{{$.data.title}}▪热度::https://api.coolapk.com/v6/page/dataList?url=#/feed/apkCommentList?id={{$.data.id}}&sort=popular&title=热度排序&page={\{page}}&lastItem=\n"
   	}
</js>
